service: ag-mctraining-426

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: python3.11
  region: ${opt:region, 'us-east-1'}
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  timeout: 10
  memorySize: 256
  stackName: user-crud-api-serverless
  environment:
    TABLE_NAME: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-users

package:
  individually: true
  patterns:
    - "!**/__pycache__/**"
    - "!**/*.pyc"
    - "!venv/**"
    - "!node_modules/**"

functions:
  createUser:
    handler: create_user/handler.lambda_handler
    role: !GetAtt CreateUserExecutionRole.Arn
    package:
      patterns:
        - "create_user/**"
    events:
      - http:
          path: users
          method: post
          cors: true

  getUser:
    handler: get_user/handler.lambda_handler
    role: !GetAtt GetUserExecutionRole.Arn
    package:
      patterns:
        - "get_user/**"
    events:
      - http:
          path: users/{id}
          method: get
          cors: true

  updateUser:
    handler: update_user/handler.lambda_handler
    role: !GetAtt UpdateUserExecutionRole.Arn
    package:
      patterns:
        - "update_user/**"
    events:
      - http:
          path: users/{id}
          method: put
          cors: true

  deleteUser:
    handler: delete_user/handler.lambda_handler
    role: !GetAtt DeleteUserExecutionRole.Arn
    package:
      patterns:
        - "delete_user/**"
    events:
      - http:
          path: users/{id}
          method: delete
          cors: true

resources:
  Resources:
    CreateUserExecutionRole:
      Type: AWS::IAM::Role
      Properties:
        RoleName: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-create-user-role
        AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
          Version: "2012-10-17"
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service:
                  - lambda.amazonaws.com
              Action:
                - sts:AssumeRole
        Policies:
          - PolicyName: create-user-policy
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: "2012-10-17"
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - dynamodb:PutItem
                  Resource:
                    - !GetAtt UsersTable.Arn

    GetUserExecutionRole:
      Type: AWS::IAM::Role
      Properties:
        RoleName: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-get-user-role
        AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
          Version: "2012-10-17"
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service:
                  - lambda.amazonaws.com
              Action:
                - sts:AssumeRole
        Policies:
          - PolicyName: get-user-policy
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: "2012-10-17"
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - dynamodb:GetItem
                  Resource:
                    - !GetAtt UsersTable.Arn

    UpdateUserExecutionRole:
      Type: AWS::IAM::Role
      Properties:
        RoleName: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-update-user-role
        AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
          Version: "2012-10-17"
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service:
                  - lambda.amazonaws.com
              Action:
                - sts:AssumeRole
        Policies:
          - PolicyName: update-user-policy
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: "2012-10-17"
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  Resource:
                    - !GetAtt UsersTable.Arn

    DeleteUserExecutionRole:
      Type: AWS::IAM::Role
      Properties:
        RoleName: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-delete-user-role
        AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
          Version: "2012-10-17"
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service:
                  - lambda.amazonaws.com
              Action:
                - sts:AssumeRole
        Policies:
          - PolicyName: delete-user-policy
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: "2012-10-17"
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  Resource:
                    - !GetAtt UsersTable.Arn

    UsersTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.TABLE_NAME}
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: id
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: id
            KeyType: HASH
